explanation: Compare k with the left subtree’s stored size. Descend left, return the current node, or subtract the left subtree and root before descending right. The wrapper initializes sizes first.
timeComplexity: O(h) rank search; O(n) including wrapper size initialization
spaceComplexity: O(1) rank-search state; O(h) wrapper recursion
